prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.labelOverlay = function(input)
Behavior: Parse base;operations. Base is comma-separated unique key=value labels; operations are set:key=value or unset:key and apply in order. Keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Values are non-empty printable ASCII without comma or semicolon. Return final labels sorted by key, or invalid input.
Visible example: a=one,b=two;unset:a,set:b=three,set:c=four returns b=three,c=four.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Values are non-empty printable ASCII without comma or semicolon. Return final labels sorted by key, or invalid input.

reference.code:
const f=s=>{const p=s.split(';'),d=new Map,k=/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/,ok=v=>v.length>0&&[...v].every(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)>=32&&c.charCodeAt(0)<=126&&!',;'.includes(c));if(p.length!==2)return null;if(p[0])for(const r of p[0].split(',')){const at=r.indexOf('='),a=r.slice(0,at),v=r.slice(at+1);if(at<0||!k.test(a)||!ok(v)||d.has(a))return null;d.set(a,v)}if(p[1])for(const op of p[1].split(',')){if(op.startsWith('set:')){const x=op.slice(4),at=x.indexOf('='),a=x.slice(0,at),v=x.slice(at+1);if(at<0||!k.test(a)||!ok(v))return null;d.set(a,v)}else if(op.startsWith('unset:')&&k.test(op.slice(6)))d.delete(op.slice(6));else return null}return[...d].sort().map(x=>x[0]+'='+x[1]).join(',')};
exports.labelOverlay=f;
